 Care
 HOW TO CARE FOR YOUR LEATHER ACCESSORIES AND APPAREL
- 
 Remove dust and dirt:   Gently brush off dust or use a soft, damp cloth to clean the surface.
- 
 Clean with a damp cloth:   Wipe down the leather with a damp cloth to remove any remaining dirt.
- 
 Hydrate with leather cream:   Apply a small amount of leather cream to keep the leather soft and prevent cracking.
- 
 Polish lightly:   Use a soft cloth to lightly polish the leather, restoring its natural shine.
- 
 Protect from moisture:   Avoid exposing your leather items to excessive moisture to prevent damage.
- 
 Store properly:   Keep your leather accessories in a cool, dry place, and use padded hangers or shoe trees to maintain their shape.
- 
 Use dust bags:   Store smaller items like handbags and wallets in dust bags to protect them from dust and scratches.
- 
 Condition regularly:   Regularly condition your leather items with appropriate products to extend their lifespan.
- 
 Avoid direct sunlight:   Keep leather items away from direct sunlight to prevent fading and drying out.
- 
 Handle with care:   Treat your leather items gently to maintain their quality and appearance over time.
